capabilities.label: AI agent / tool execution
capabilities.rule: Reuse one already-authorized agent; don't start competing schedulers.

capabilities.label: Work messages and decisions
capabilities.rule: Feishu remains the system of record; use lark-cli for read-only, identity-scoped extraction.

capabilities.label: Personal events
capabilities.rule: One authoritative calendar; read-only aggregation elsewhere.

capabilities.label: Personal reminders
capabilities.rule: Create only after explicit confirmation in native provider.

capabilities.label: Phone shortcuts and quick capture
capabilities.rule: Use native shortcut entry points, no duplicate client.

capabilities.label: Item inventory and warranty
capabilities.rule: HomeBox owns item details, photos, labels and maintenance.

capabilities.label: Notes and long-term documents
capabilities.rule: Notes remain in the user's existing vault.

capabilities.label: Cross-source visual overview
capabilities.rule: Optional view with source links; not a second master database.

capabilities.label: Feishu work tasks (not Apple Reminders)
capabilities.rule: Read from user OAuth; do not mirror to personal DB unless explicitly allowed.

capabilities.label: Feishu work calendar (not Apple Calendar)
capabilities.rule: Missing calendar scope = BLOCKED, never interpret as no meetings.
